snippet.title: TARAE: The Unbound — Official Reveal Teaser | gamescom ONL 2026
snippet.description:
Sever Fate.

TARAE: The Unbound is a top-down action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy world.
Master one of six seekers, overwhelm relentless hordes,
and break through fearsome bosses on Taegwido — an island born from the collapse of the Six Realms.

*Alpha gameplay footage, Subject to change

Wishlist TARAE: The Unbound on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4604540/TARAE_The_Unbound
